name: gh-review-loop
description: AI code-review PR loop for Claude Code and Codex. Reads real review-thread state, fixes findings by severity, verifies against your own tests, and stops at a hard cycle cap.

plugins.name: gh-review-loop
plugins.description: Clears AI reviewer feedback on your PR: reads real review-thread state, fixes findings by severity, sweeps whole patterns in one cycle, gates every push on your repo's own tests, then requests re-review — hard-capped so it can never spam the PR. Works with Gemini Code Assist and Codex out of the box, or any compatible reviewer bot you configure.
